import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    s = next(it).decode()
    beauty = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    total_beauty = sum(beauty)

    half = n // 2
    equal_pairs = []
    char_occurrences = [0] * 128
    most_common_char = 'a'

    for i in range(half):
        if s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]:
            equal_pairs.append(i)
            ch = s[i]
            char_occurrences[ord(ch)] += 1
            if char_occurrences[ord(ch)] > char_occurrences[ord(most_common_char)]:
                most_common_char = ch

    ans = total_beauty
    for idx in equal_pairs:
        ans -= min(beauty[idx], beauty[n - 1 - idx])

    if char_occurrences[ord(most_common_char)] > len(equal_pairs) // 2:
        penalties = []
        for j in range(half):
            if s[j] != s[n - 1 - j] and s[j] != most_common_char and s[n - 1 - j] != most_common_char:
                penalties.append(min(beauty[j], beauty[n - 1 - j]))
        penalties.sort()
        rem = 2 * char_occurrences[ord(most_common_char)] - len(equal_pairs)
        for k in range(rem):
            ans -= penalties[k]

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
